components.name: Tactile Button Primary
components.description: Primary action button with neumorphic glow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #3388FF; color: white; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 2.5rem; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); box-shadow: 5px 5px 10px rgba(51, 136, 255, 0.3), -5px -5px 10px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8); transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.275); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(51, 136, 255, 0.5); }

components.name: Project Slab
components.description: Raised neumorphic card for project display.
components.css: .ds-project-slab { background: #F0F2F5; border-radius: 2.5rem; padding: 32px; box-shadow: 15px 15px 30px #d1d9e6, -15px -15px 30px #ffffff; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6); } .ds-text { color: #1E293B; font-family: sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: Sistem desain neumorphic yang mensimulasikan permukaan fisik dan kontrol taktil. Fokus pada interaksi 'nyata' melalui bayangan ganda.

rules.name: The Shadow-as-State Rule
rules.body: Bayangan luar = raised, bayangan dalam = inset.
